# Codex Token Bar v0.8.0
v0.8.0 把 Codex Token Bar 从用量看板推进为本地优先的 Codex 会话、续跑、雷达与额度控制台，并同步覆盖 macOS Swift 原生版和 Windows Tauri 跨平台版。
## 主要更新
- **安全自动续跑**：先选择项目文件夹和精确会话，再按固定间隔、每日时间、额度恢复或明确的服务器容量中断发送一次“继续”。执行链使用官方 Codex app-server，默认关闭，发送前复核会话是否已由用户推进，也不会替用户批准命令、文件权限或回答人工输入。 - **完整会话选择器**：项目按最近活动排序，每个项目默认展示最近 100 个会话标题；搜索覆盖项目完整结果，支持回车和箭头刷新，同一目录下的多个任务不会被错误去重。 - **会话增强工具**：顶部新增独立“会话增强 / 自动续跑”入口。会话增强支持侧栏删除、Markdown 导出、移动到项目、会话 ID、粘贴修复、阅读宽度和滚动位置恢复；临时菜单支持点外、失焦、Escape、滚动和窗口切换自动收起。 - **双雷达与众测排行**：主界面把官方 Radar 和众测雷达并排展示；详情页和悬浮窗可查看众测前三名、完整排行、任务/单元覆盖和贡献者数据。跨平台版改用原生网络请求绕过浏览器 CORS，双端解析器兼容包装层、字段别名、字符串数字和局部坏行。 - **更可靠的 Radar 数据**：官方 Radar 按区块独立解码，兼容额度字段和 JSON 层级变化；缺失数据保持“不可用”，不会被伪造成 0。已有健康快照时，刷新失败会继续显示旧数据并明确标记。 - **额度与历史分析增强**：24 小时图表即使选中额度为零或没有额度变化的区间也会显示总计框；悬浮窗到期时间支持小数天；额度条可按相对均速自适应配色。顶部新增“累计薅到（估）”，以历史 API 等值减公开套餐月费，并保留清晰估算说明。 - **总体设置重构**：Swift 与 Tauri 使用统一的九类设置，包括常规、显示面、监控与额度、悬浮窗、内容与排序、提醒与更新、数据与维护、会话增强和自动续跑；高频入口仍保留在主界面。 - **悬浮窗信息密度优化**：众测雷达成为独立整行，展示前三名且与官方 Radar 分栏线对齐；Radar 与众测之间更紧凑，众测与额度条仍保留正常留白。 - **本地性能和磁盘写入优化**：Tauri 改用增量缓存与节流持久化，Swift 减少后台重复读取，未读扫描和实时速率链路降低无效 I/O；大规模本地 Codex 历史下仍保持 fail-closed 与可重建缓存隔离。 - **Windows 构建兼容性**：进程存活判断显式采用 Win32 退出码类型，确保 x64 与 ARM64 构建兼容当前 `windows-sys` 绑定。 - **会话删除可靠性加固**：修复 Chromium Origin、`local:<UUID>`、React reconciliation 回收按钮、旧事件处理器和 WebSocket 回执路由问题；真实删除仍走官方 `codex delete --force`，不直接手术 SQLite。
## 说明
- 自动续跑与会话增强均需用户主动启用；默认不会发送提示词、重启 Codex 或修改真实会话。 - 由于正式集成并改编 Codex++ 的 AGPL-3.0 功能，本组合工程从本版起以 GNU AGPL v3 发布；原 Codex Token Bar 的 MIT 许可文本和 Codex++ 来源、版本、修改说明均继续保留。 - Mac 继续使用原生 Swift App 与 Sparkle；Windows 使用 Tauri + React + Rust App 与独立的 Tauri updater metadata，两条更新通道不会混用。 - macOS 构建采用 ad-hoc 签名且未 Apple notarize；Windows 安装器未使用商业代码签名证书。请只从官方 Release 下载并核对 SHA256，系统可能显示未知开发者或未知发布者提示。 - 实时速率和累计节省均为本地估算；本地用量、会话、额度、重置卡和 Radar 数据不会作为遥测上传。
---
## English
# Codex Token Bar v0.8.0
v0.8.0 advances Codex Token Bar from a usage dashboard into a local-first Codex session, resume, Radar, and quota console across both the native macOS Swift build and the Windows Tauri build.
## Highlights
- **Safe automatic resume**: choose a project and exact conversation, then continue on a fixed interval, local daily time, quota recovery, or a confirmed server-capacity interruption. The flow uses the official Codex app-server, is off by default, rechecks whether the user already advanced the conversation, and never approves commands, file permissions, or interactive prompts on the user's behalf. - **Complete conversation picker**: projects are sorted by recent activity and each project shows up to 100 recent titles by default. Search covers the project's full loaded result set, Enter and the arrow button both refresh, and multiple conversations in one directory are never collapsed into one. - **Session enhancement tools**: separate Session Enhancements and Auto Resume entries are available from the top toolbar. Enhancements include sidebar deletion, Markdown export, project moves, session IDs, paste repair, reading width, and scroll restoration. Temporary menus dismiss on outside click, focus loss, Escape, scroll, resize, or window blur. - **Dual Radar and crowd ranking**: official Radar and Crowd Radar sit side by side on the dashboard. Detail and floating surfaces show the crowd top three, full ranking, task/cell coverage, and contributors. Tauri now reads the public endpoints through the native layer to avoid browser CORS, while both parsers tolerate wrappers, aliases, numeric strings, and malformed individual rows. - **More resilient Radar data**: official Radar blocks decode independently and tolerate quota-field and JSON-wrapper changes. Missing data remains unavailable instead of becoming a fabricated zero, and a failed refresh keeps a healthy prior snapshot with an explicit stale marker. - **Better quota and history analysis**: a selected 24-hour range still shows its total summary when quota stays at zero or does not change. Floating expiry supports fractional days, quota colors can follow relative pace, and the header adds an explainable lifetime “saved estimate” based on API value minus public plan fees. - **Redesigned settings**: Swift and Tauri share nine categories for General, Surfaces, Monitoring & Quota, Floating Panel, Content & Order, Alerts & Updates, Data & Maintenance, Session Enhancements, and Auto Resume, while frequent actions remain available on the dashboard. - **Denser floating layout**: Crowd Radar owns a separate full-width row with the top three and a divider aligned to official Radar. Radar-to-crowd spacing is tighter without compressing the normal gap before quota. - **Lower local I/O cost**: Tauri uses incremental caches and throttled persistence, Swift avoids repeated background reads, and unread/live-rate paths reduce unnecessary scanning. Rebuildable caches remain isolated and safety checks stay fail-closed on large local Codex histories. - **Windows build compatibility**: process-liveness checks now use the Win32 exit-code type explicitly, keeping x64 and ARM64 builds compatible with current `windows-sys` bindings. - **Hardened session deletion**: fixes cover Chromium Origin rejection, `local:<UUID>`, React reconciliation, stale handlers, and WebSocket response routing. Real deletion still uses official `codex delete --force` and never performs direct SQLite surgery.
## Notes
- Auto Resume and Session Enhancements require explicit user opt-in. The default configuration does not send prompts, relaunch Codex, or modify real conversations. - Because this release formally integrates and adapts Codex++ AGPL-3.0 functionality, the combined project is distributed under GNU AGPL v3 starting with this release. The original Codex Token Bar MIT text and Codex++ source/version/modification notices remain preserved. - macOS continues to use the native Swift app and Sparkle. Windows uses the Tauri + React + Rust app and separate Tauri updater metadata; the channels are not interchangeable. - The macOS build is ad-hoc signed and not Apple notarized. Windows installers do not use a commercial code-signing certificate. Download only from the official Release and verify SHA256; the operating system may show an unidentified-developer or unknown-publisher warning. - Live rate and lifetime savings are local estimates. Local usage, conversations, quota, reset-credit, and Radar data are not uploaded as telemetry.

# Codex Token Bar v0.7.3
v0.7.3 是一次覆盖 macOS Swift 原生版与 Windows Tauri 跨平台版的大型正确性、性能与界面优化。
## 主要更新
- **额度窗口自适应**：不再把官方 `primary` 固定解释成 5 小时额度。官方只提供 7 天额度时，主界面、悬浮窗、状态栏/托盘、趣味化节奏提示和历史曲线都只显示 7 天；两种额度都存在时才同时显示。 - **额度历史与异常点修正**：7 天历史不会再写入 5 小时列；根据真实本机历史序列过滤官方偶发的接近 100% 孤立跳点，同时保留真正的额度重置。 - **额度条重新布局**：Swift 与 Tauri 都把更多宽度还给进度条，刷新频率移动到顶部节奏提示右侧；完整显示“额度刷新 1 分钟”等文案，点击区域更大，不再依赖省略号。 - **缓存命中率曲线修正**：低频使用时，空时间桶不再沿用上一条命中率，消除误导性的阶梯平台；连续实测点成线，孤立实测点单独显示。 - **雷达与模型 IQ 同步**：Dashboard 和悬浮窗共享同一批 Radar 快照；双端使用相同排序，紧凑模型名保留 `max`、`medium` 等思考强度，不再出现一端显示 Sol、另一端仍显示旧 Terra 的情况。 - **克制的语义配色**：额度从低到高在红、琥珀、绿、主题蓝之间连续过渡；雷达等待/运行/关闭、高 IQ 与节奏状态使用少量明确点缀，整体卡片仍保持简洁中性。 - **顶部工具区整理**：Tauri 删除冗余产品名，检查更新和开机自启保持一级可见；更多菜单只放 CSV/PNG，并补齐方向键、Home/End、Escape、Tab、失焦和焦点恢复。Swift 来源信息与操作区分行，自动发现路径更易读。 - **辅助功能完善**：Swift 五种 Token 活动模式由真实原生 AX 按钮承载；两端活动模式、图表范围和曲线开关都能正确报告选中状态。 - **后台性能显著降低**：Swift 在主界面、悬浮窗和状态栏都不可见时暂停高成本用量、实时速率、额度和 Radar 刷新；可信快照保留，界面恢复后立即刷新。官方 unread 可用时不再无条件扫描 session JSONL。 - **来源与缓存更可靠**：来源切换、同路径替换和迟到异步结果由物理身份、binding 与 generation 共同约束；旧 Swift 用量迁移死代码已清理，Tauri 聚合缓存按 Codex Home 隔离。 - **Provider Repair 加固**：备份、同步、回滚共享同一操作租约；SQLite WAL 快照、session descriptor 身份/digest、并发 append、原子替换、同长度覆写和失败清理都纳入门禁。 - **Windows 桌面体验**：支持真正隐藏的开机自启、常驻单实例激活监听、主窗销毁后的隐藏重建，以及重复 secondary 唤醒；关键 Win32 失败不会回退成第二个主实例。 - **更新提醒常驻**：Mac Sparkle 与 Windows 应用级更新监控默认每 4 小时检查一次。自动检查只提示，不自动安装；Windows 系统通知不可用时保留持久托盘标记和安装入口。
## 说明
- Mac 继续使用原生 Swift App 与 Sparkle；Windows 使用 Tauri + React + Rust App 与独立的 Tauri updater metadata，两条更新通道不会混用。 - 自动更新只负责检查和提醒，下载、安装与重启仍需用户确认。 - macOS 构建采用 ad-hoc 签名且未 Apple notarize；Windows 安装器未使用商业代码签名证书。请只从官方 Release 下载并核对 SHA256，系统可能显示未知开发者或未知发布者提示。 - 实时速率是工作强度估计，不代表精确吞吐；本地使用量、会话、额度、重置卡和 Radar 数据不会作为遥测上传。 - 完整工程报告见 `audits/v0.7.3/reports/optimization-report.md`。
---
## English
# Codex Token Bar v0.7.3
v0.7.3 is a broad correctness, performance, accessibility, and interface update across the native macOS Swift app and the Windows Tauri app.
## Highlights
- **Adaptive quota windows**: the app no longer assumes that the API `primary` window is always 5 hours. If Codex exposes only the 7-day window, the dashboard, floating panel, status/tray surface, pace hint, and history chart show only 7d. Both windows appear only when both are actually available. - **Correct quota history and spike handling**: 7-day samples no longer land in the 5-hour series. Isolated near-100% API spikes are filtered from real local history while genuine resets remain visible. - **Longer, clearer quota bars**: both apps return more space to the tracks and place the quota-refresh selector beside the top pace hint. Full labels such as “Quota refresh 1 minute” remain visible with a larger hit target and no ellipsis fallback. - **Low-activity cache-hit charts**: empty buckets are now unknown instead of carrying the last measured rate forward, removing misleading stair-step plateaus. - **Shared Radar and IQ ranking**: dashboards and floating surfaces consume one shared Radar snapshot. Both implementations rank the same data and retain reasoning effort such as `max` or `medium` in compact model labels. - **Restrained semantic color**: quota moves continuously from red through amber and green to the product blue. Radar state, high IQ, and pace hints use a small number of meaningful accents while cards remain neutral. - **Cleaner top controls**: Tauri keeps update checking and autostart as visible primary actions, with CSV/PNG in an accessible keyboard-complete menu. Swift separates source context from actions so auto-discovered paths remain readable. - **Better accessibility**: the five Swift Token activity modes are real native accessibility buttons. Equivalent activity, chart-range, and line controls report selected state on both platforms. - **Much lower hidden background cost**: Swift pauses expensive usage, live-rate, quota, and Radar owners while every surface is hidden, retains trusted snapshots, and refreshes immediately on resume. Official unread state avoids unconditional session JSONL scans. - **Safer source and cache ownership**: physical source identity, bindings, and generations reject stale asynchronous completions. Swift legacy usage migration residue is removed, and Tauri aggregate caches remain scoped to the exact Codex Home. - **Provider Repair hardening**: backup, sync, and rollback share one lease. WAL snapshots, descriptor identity and digest checks, concurrent append/replacement/overwrite handling, and failure cleanup are covered by execution tests. - **Reliable Windows desktop lifecycle**: hidden autostart, persistent single-instance activation, destroyed-main recreation, and repeated secondary activation are supported without creating a second primary. - **Persistent update ownership**: macOS Sparkle and the Windows app-level monitor check every four hours by default. Automatic checks announce availability only; Windows retains a persistent tray fallback when system notifications are unavailable.
## Notes
- macOS continues to use the native Swift app and Sparkle. Windows uses the Tauri + React + Rust app and separate Tauri updater metadata; the channels are not interchangeable. - Automatic updating checks and presents availability only. Download, installation, and restart still require user confirmation. - The macOS build is ad-hoc signed and not Apple notarized. Windows installers do not use a commercial code-signing certificate. Download only from the official Release and verify SHA256; the operating system may show an unidentified-developer or unknown-publisher warning. - Live rate is a work-intensity estimate, not exact throughput. Local usage, session, quota, reset-credit, and Radar data are not uploaded as telemetry. - The complete engineering report is available at `audits/v0.7.3/reports/optimization-report.md`.

# Codex Token Bar v0.7.2
这次是 Mac Swift 版的稳定性更新，重点修正本地统计口径、实时速率、雷达详情刷新、曲线图浏览和额度刷新设置。Windows / Tauri 版本继续走自己的更新路线，不共用 Mac appcast。
## 更新亮点
- 修复 fork 会话重复统计：分支会话开头复制出来的历史 token 不再被重复算进总量，fork 后新的真实调用仍会正常计入。 - 稳定 `总 / 今 / 次` 指标：准备精确 token 缓存或只能读取元数据时，不再用临时数据冒充精确统计，也不会清掉上一份可信结果。 - 曲线图支持横向浏览历史：24h、7d、30d 都可以保持原来的显示区域，通过滚动和左右按钮查看更久之前的数据；30d 可用更细颗粒度浏览。 - 新增额度刷新频率设置：可在 30 秒、1 分钟、3 分钟、5 分钟、10 分钟之间选择，主界面和悬浮窗共用同一个设置。 - 雷达接入公开摘要和详情刷新：基础/悬浮显示继续使用公开 `current.json`，详情数据按本地 08:00 / 18:00 定时刷新，并避免失败后同一时段反复自动重试。 - 实时速率继续修正：切换 Codex Home 时会重置来源状态，坏日志或无效时间戳不会制造虚假尖峰，显示保持一位小数。 - 增加未读会话一键已读：状态栏和相关入口可以更方便地处理未读会话提醒。 - 强化 Provider 同步和额度历史的过期回写保护，减少后台任务慢完成时覆盖新状态的风险。 - 兼容新版 ChatGPT 内置 Codex CLI：额度读取会依次尝试显式路径、LaunchServices、系统/用户 Applications、PATH 与 Homebrew，不再依赖固定 App 名称或单一安装位置。 - 收紧 Codex App 身份校验：自动发现只接受正确的 `com.openai.codex` App，避免误用其他软件附带的同名可执行文件；Provider 同步也能识别改名后的 ChatGPT/Codex 进程。
## 更新说明
- Mac 版仍使用原生 Swift App、DMG 安装包和 Sparkle appcast；Windows 版请使用 Windows 对应资产。 - 实时速率仍然只是工作强度估计，不代表精确真实吞吐。 - 本地 token、缓存命中、会话统计、额度历史、重置卡和雷达信息不会上传到第三方。 - 当前构建仍是 ad-hoc 签名，尚未 Apple notarize。如果 macOS 提示“未知开发者”，请从官方 Release 下载并校验 SHA256 后再打开。
---
## English
This is a stability update for the native Mac Swift build. It focuses on local usage accounting, live-rate behavior, Radar detail refresh, chart browsing, and quota refresh cadence. The Windows / Tauri build continues to use its own update lane and must not use the Mac appcast.
## Highlights
- Fixes duplicated fork-session usage: replayed history at the beginning of a forked session is no longer counted again, while real calls after the fork still count normally. - Stabilizes total / today / current-call metrics: precise-cache preparation and metadata-only states no longer masquerade as trusted totals or clear the last trusted result. - Adds horizontally scrollable history charts: 24h, 7d, and 30d charts keep the original viewport size while scroll buttons and trackpad scrolling reveal older history; 30d can be viewed with finer granularity. - Adds quota refresh cadence settings: choose 30 seconds, 1 minute, 3 minutes, 5 minutes, or 10 minutes. Dashboard and floating panel share the same setting. - Improves Codex Radar loading: compact/basic surfaces keep using the public `current.json`, while full detail refreshes on the local 08:00 / 18:00 schedule and avoids repeated automatic retries for the same failed slot. - Refines live-rate behavior: switching Codex Home resets source-local live-rate state, malformed timestamps no longer create fake spikes, and displayed values keep one decimal. - Adds one-click mark-read support for unread session reminders. - Hardens Provider sync and quota-history state publishing so slower background work is less likely to overwrite newer state. - Supports the Codex CLI bundled with the renamed ChatGPT app: quota reading now checks an explicit override, LaunchServices, system/user Applications, PATH, and Homebrew instead of relying on a fixed app name or install location. - Tightens Codex app identity checks: automatic discovery accepts only the expected `com.openai.codex` app, avoiding unrelated bundled executables with the same filename, while Provider sync recognizes the renamed ChatGPT/Codex process.
## Notes
- The Mac build still uses the native Swift app, DMG installer, and Sparkle appcast updates. Use the Windows assets for Windows. - Live rate remains a work-intensity estimate, not exact throughput. - Local token usage, cache hit rates, session statistics, quota history, reset-credit data, and Radar data are not uploaded to third parties. - The app remains ad-hoc signed and is not Apple notarized. Verify the SHA256 checksum before opening if macOS warns about an unidentified developer.

# Codex Token Bar v0.7.0
这次更新把 Mac 版继续稳定在原生 Swift 路线：重点改进了实时速率显示、用量统计刷新性能、额度反推工具、重置卡详情和悬浮窗细节。Windows 版同样使用 `0.7.0` 版本号，但会按 Windows 自己的构建与更新路线发布。
## 更新亮点
- 用量统计改为增量刷新：手动刷新和自动刷新仍然是真刷新，但只处理新增或变化的会话文件，减少大体量历史数据下的重复扫描和缓存重写。 - 实时速率更像“工作强度估计”：速度显示加入轻量平滑、显示上限和工具输入估算，降低 300-500 tok/s 这类离谱跳值；主界面也明确说明该速率只是估算。 - 可以关闭实时速率：不想看速率的人可以直接关闭，主界面会变暗提示，悬浮窗里的速率模块也会同步关闭或开启。 - 速度条更省性能：速度条填充改为 layer-backed 渲染，保留平滑过渡，但避免 SwiftUI Shape 动画持续占用 CPU。 - 新增额度反推工具：在最近 24 小时曲线上选择起止范围后，可以根据 token 用量、缓存命中率、官方 API 定价和额度下降反推 5h / 7d 的估计总额度。 - 额度曲线更稳：读取额度历史时会过滤明显异常的瞬间 100 / 0 跳点，并在中间缺失记录时平滑连接正常下降段。 - 重置卡详情更清楚：主界面显示最近一张卡还剩多久，详情列表按最近到期排序，默认收起，只保留头像、剩余时间和进度条，点击后展开原因、关联用户、到期时间和卡片编号。 - 悬浮窗继续打磨：趣味化余量、雷达、额度条、总/今/次调用的排版和自适应文字颜色继续调整，速率条上和居中状态使用不同字号。
## 更新说明
- Mac 版仍使用 Swift 原生 App、DMG 安装包和 Sparkle appcast 更新；Windows 版请使用 Windows 对应资产，不要混用 Mac 的 appcast。 - 速率显示只用于判断 Codex 是否正在工作，不代表精确真实吞吐。官方为避免高频日志写入损耗硬盘，已经砍掉了很多流式输出日志。 - 额度反推是估算工具，7d 下降太少、记录颗粒度太粗或遇到异常额度点时，结果可能偏差较大；界面会显示 7d / 5h 倍率辅助判断可信度。 - 本地 token、缓存命中、会话统计、额度历史和重置卡信息仍然来自本机 Codex 数据与本地账号接口。 - Codex Token Bar 不会上传 prompt、输出、日志、会话内容或账号额度。 - Sparkle 更新仍然需要用户确认，不会在后台静默替换 App。 - 当前构建仍是 ad-hoc 签名，尚未 Apple notarize。如果 macOS 提示“未知开发者”，请从官方 Release 下载并校验 SHA256 后再打开。

## English
This update keeps the Mac build on the native Swift lane. It focuses on live-rate display stability, incremental usage refresh performance, quota estimation, reset-credit details, and floating-panel polish. The Windows build also uses version `0.7.0`, but it should be released through the Windows-specific build and update path.
## Highlights
- Makes usage refresh incremental: manual and automatic refreshes still perform real refreshes, but only new or changed session files are processed, reducing repeated scans and large cache rewrites. - Makes live rate feel more like a work-intensity estimate: lightweight smoothing, display caps, and tool-input estimation reduce unrealistic 300-500 tok/s spikes, and the dashboard now explains that the rate is only an estimate. - Adds a live-rate off switch: users who do not want live rate can disable it. The dashboard dims the rate area, and the floating-panel rate module follows the same setting. - Improves speed-bar performance: the speed fill is now layer-backed, keeping smooth visual transitions while avoiding continuous SwiftUI Shape animation CPU cost. - Adds quota back-estimation: select a range on the recent 24-hour chart to estimate 5h / 7d total quota from token usage, cache hit rate, official API pricing, and quota drops. - Stabilizes quota curves: obvious instant 100 / 0 anomaly points are filtered, and normal drops are connected smoothly across missing history gaps. - Clarifies reset-credit details: the dashboard shows the nearest expiring credit, the detail list is sorted by expiry, rows stay collapsed by default, and each row can expand to show reason, linked user, expiry time, and card ID. - Polishes the floating panel: playful quota hints, Radar data, quota bars, and total/today/current calls receive further layout and adaptive text-color tuning, with separate font sizes for embedded and centered hint styles.
## Update Notes
- The Mac build still uses the native Swift app, DMG installer, and Sparkle appcast updates. Use the Windows assets for Windows; do not mix the Mac appcast into the Windows update lane. - Live rate is only a rough signal that Codex is working, not an exact throughput measurement. Official Codex builds now suppress many high-frequency streaming logs to avoid excessive disk writes. - Quota back-estimation is approximate. If the 7d quota barely moves, history granularity is coarse, or anomalous quota points appear, the result may drift; the UI shows the 7d / 5h ratio as a confidence hint. - Local token usage, cache hit rates, session statistics, quota history, and reset-credit data still come from local Codex files and local account endpoints. - Codex Token Bar does not upload prompts, outputs, logs, conversation content, or quota data. - Sparkle updates still require user confirmation; the app does not silently replace itself in the background. - The app remains ad-hoc signed and is not Apple notarized. Verify the SHA256 checksum before opening if macOS warns about an unidentified developer.
